Direction queue to avoid reversing within a single tick.

js
Copy
Download
function setDir(nx,ny){
  const last = queue.length ? queue[queue.length-1] : dir;
  if(last.x === -nx && last.y === -ny) return; // no reverse
  if(last.x === nx && last.y === ny) return;
  if(queue.length < 2) queue.push({x:nx,y:ny});
}

Step:

js
Copy
Download
function step(){
  if(state !== 'running') return;
  if(queue.length) dir = queue.shift();
  const head = {x:snake[0].x+dir.x, y:snake[0].y+dir.y};
  if(head.x<0||head.x>=COLS||head.y<0||head.y>=ROWS|| snake.some(s=>s.x===head.x&&s.y===head.y)){
    gameOver(); return;
  }
  snake.unshift(head);
  if(head.x===food.x && head.y===food.y){
    score+=10; elScore.textContent=score;
    Sound.play('eat');
    if(score>best){best=score; localStorage.setItem('gz_snake_best',best); elBest.textContent=best;}
    // speed up
    const lvl = Math.min(10, 1+Math.floor(score/50));
    elSpeed.textContent = lvl;
    speedMs = Math.max(60, 150 - (lvl-1)*10);
    placeFood();
  } else {
    snake.pop();
  }
  draw();
  timer = setTimeout(step, speedMs);
}

Touch swipe on canvas:

js
Copy

let touchStart=null;
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e=>{const t=e.changedTouches[0]; touchStart={x:t.clientX,y:t.clientY};}, {passive:true});
canvas.addEventListener('touchend', e=>{
  if(!touchStart) return;
  const t = e.changedTouches[0];
  const dx = t.clientX - touchStart.x, dy = t.clientY - touchStart.y;
  if(Math.abs(dx)<24 && Math.abs(dy)<24) return;
  if(Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy)) setDir(dx>0?1:-1,0); else setDir(0, dy>0?1:-1);
  touchStart=null;
});

Computer picks:

js

function computerMove(){
  if(history.length>=3 && Math.random()<0.55){
    // counter most frequent
    const counts = {rock:0,paper:0,scissors:0};
    history.slice(-12).forEach(m=>counts[m]++);
    const most = Object.keys(counts).sort((a,b)=>counts[b]-counts[a])[0];
    return counterOf(most);
  }
  return randomOf(['rock','paper','scissors']);
}

Implementation with Web Audio:

js
Copy

const Sound = (()=>{
  let ctx = null;
  let enabled = true;
  let musicOn = false;
  let musicNode = null;
  let musicTimer = null;

  function getCtx(){
    if(!ctx){
      const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
      if(!AC) return null;
      ctx = new AC();
    }
    if(ctx.state === 'suspended') ctx.resume();
    return ctx;
  }

  function tone(freq, dur=0.1, type='sine', vol=0.12, when=0, slideTo=null){
    const c = getCtx(); if(!c || !enabled) return;
    const t0 = c.currentTime + when;
    const osc = c.createOscillator();
    const g = c.createGain();
    osc.type = type;
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t0);
    if(slideTo) osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(slideTo, t0+dur);
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t0);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vol, t0+0.012);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0+dur);
    osc.connect(g).connect(c.destination);
    osc.start(t0); osc.stop(t0+dur+0.02);
  }
  ...
})();

osc.connect(g).connect(c.destination) — connect returns the destination node, so chaining works. Yes, AudioNode.connect returns the destination node.

const SCALE = [220, 261.63, 293.66, 329.63, 392, 440, 523.25];
function startMusic(){
  const c = getCtx(); if(!c) return;
  musicOn = true;
  let i = 0;
  const tick = ()=>{
    if(!musicOn) return;
    const f = SCALE[i % SCALE.length];
    tone(f, 0.9, 'triangle', 0.045);
    tone(f/2, 1.2, 'sine', 0.03);
    i++;
    musicTimer = setTimeout(tick, 480);
  };
  tick();
}

/* ---------- BACKGROUND PARTICLES ---------- */
(function particles(){
  const canvas = document.getElementById('bgCanvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let w, h, dpr, parts = [];
  function resize(){
    dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1, 2);
    w = canvas.width = innerWidth*dpr;
    h = canvas.height = innerHeight*dpr;
    canvas.style.width = innerWidth+'px';
    canvas.style.height = innerHeight+'px';
    const count = Math.min(90, Math.floor(innerWidth*innerHeight/18000));
    parts = Array.from({length:count}, ()=>({
      x: Math.random()*w,
      y: Math.random()*h,
      r: (Math.random()*1.8+0.6)*dpr,
      vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*0.25*dpr,
      vy: (Math.random()-0.5)*0.25*dpr,
      hue: Math.random()<0.5? 275 : 190,
      a: Math.random()*0.5+0.25
    }));
  }
  function loop(){
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
    for(const p of parts){
      p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy;
      if(p.x<-10) p.x = w+10; if(p.x>w+10) p.x=-10;
      if(p.y<-10) p.y = h+10; if(p.y>h+10) p.y=-10;
      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(p.x,p.y,0,p.x,p.y,p.r*6);
      g.addColorStop(0, `hsla(${p.hue},100%,70%,${p.a})`);
      g.addColorStop(1, `hsla(${p.hue},100%,70%,0)`);
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r*6,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  addEventListener('resize', resize);
  resize(); loop();
})();

Creating radial gradients per particle per frame is expensive (90 gradients/frame). Might be ok but let's optimize: pre-render two sprite canvases (purple & cyan glow) and drawImage. Better.

js

function makeSprite(hue){
  const s = document.createElement('canvas');
  s.width = s.height = 64;
  const c = s.getContext('2d');
  const g = c.createRadialGradient(32,32,0,32,32,32);
  g.addColorStop(0, `hsla(${hue},100%,75%,1)`);
  g.addColorStop(0.35, `hsla(${hue},100%,65%,0.45)`);
  g.addColorStop(1, `hsla(${hue},100%,65%,0)`);
  c.fillStyle = g; c.fillRect(0,0,64,64);
  return s;
}

Then ctx.drawImage(sprite, p.x - r, p.y - r, r*2, r*2) with globalAlpha = p.a.

function draw(){
  const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  // board bg
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8,4,20,0.55)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  // grid
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(150,120,255,0.08)';
  ctx.lineWidth=1;
  for(let i=1;i<COLS;i++){
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(i*CELL,0); ctx.lineTo(i*CELL,H); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,i*CELL); ctx.lineTo(W,i*CELL); ctx.stroke();
  }
  // food
  const t = performance.now()/300;
  const pulse = 1 + Math.sin(t)*0.12;
  const fx = food.x*CELL + CELL/2, fy = food.y*CELL + CELL/2;
  const grd = ctx.createRadialGradient(fx,fy,0,fx,fy,CELL*1.6*pulse);
  grd.addColorStop(0,'rgba(244,114,182,0.95)');
  grd.addColorStop(0.4,'rgba(244,114,182,0.35)');
  grd.addColorStop(1,'rgba(244,114,182,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle=grd;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(fx,fy,CELL*1.6*pulse,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffd1ea';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(fx,fy,CELL*0.34,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  // snake
  snake.forEach((seg,i)=>{
    const x = seg.x*CELL, y = seg.y*CELL;
    const p = i/Math.max(1,snake.length-1);
    const hue = 275 - p*90;
    ctx.fillStyle = `hsl(${hue}, 90%, ${62 - p*18}%)`;
    ctx.shadowColor = `hsla(${hue},100%,60%,0.9)`;
    ctx.shadowBlur = i===0? 18 : 8;
    roundRect(ctx, x+1.5, y+1.5, CELL-3, CELL-3, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  });
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  // eyes on head
  ...
}

js

function roundRect(c,x,y,w,h,r){
  if(c.roundRect){ c.beginPath(); c.roundRect(x,y,w,h,r); return; }
  c.beginPath();
  c.moveTo(x+r,y);
  c.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
  c.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
  c.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
  c.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
  c.closePath();
}

const GameHub = (()=>{
  const overlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
  const titleEl = document.getElementById('gameTitle');
  const panels = $$('.game-panel');
  let current = null;

  const meta = {
    snake:   {title:'SNAKE',        api:()=>Snake},
    ttt:     {title:'TIC-TAC-TOE',  api:()=>TTT},
    rps:     {title:'ROCK PAPER SCISSORS', api:()=>RPS},
    memory:  {title:'MEMORY MATCH', api:()=>Memory},
    whack:   {title:'WHACK-A-MOLE', api:()=>Whack}
  };

  function open(id){
    if(current && meta[current].api().leave) meta[current].api().leave();
    current = id;
    panels.forEach(p=>p.classList.toggle('active', p.id === 'panel-'+id));
    titleEl.textContent = meta[id].title;
    overlay.classList.add('open');
    document.body.classList.add('no-scroll');
    const api = meta[id].api();
    if(api.enter) api.enter();
    overlay.scrollTop = 0;
    Sound.click();
  }
  function close(){
    if(current && meta[current].api().leave) meta[current].api().leave();
    current = null;
    overlay.classList.remove('open');
    document.body.classList.remove('no-scroll');
    refreshBests();
  }
  return {open, close, get current(){return current;}};
})();
