function draw(){
  // bg
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#0d0622'); g.addColorStop(1,'#050210');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  // subtle grid lines
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(150,120,255,.06)';
  ...

  // bricks
  for (const b of bricks){
    if (!b.alive) continue;
    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(b.x,b.y,b.x,b.y+b.h);
    grad.addColorStop(0, `hsl(${b.hue},90%,66%)`);
    grad.addColorStop(1, `hsl(${b.hue-20},85%,48%)`);
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.shadowColor = `hsla(${b.hue},100%,65%,.85)`;
    ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
    roundRect(ctx, b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 5);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

  // paddle
  const pg = ctx.createLinearGradient(paddle.x,0,paddle.x+paddle.w,0);
  pg.addColorStop(0,'#22d3ee'); pg.addColorStop(1,'#a855f7');
  ctx.fillStyle = pg;
  ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(34,211,238,.9)'; ctx.shadowBlur = 18;
  roundRect(ctx, paddle.x, PADDLE_Y, paddle.w, PADDLE_H, 6); ctx.fill();
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

  // ball
  const bg2 = ctx.createRadialGradient(ball.x, ball.y, 0, ball.x, ball.y, BALL_R*2.6);
  bg2.addColorStop(0,'#ffffff'); bg2.addColorStop(.45,'#c4b5fd'); bg2.addColorStop(1,'rgba(168,85,247,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = bg2;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, BALL_R*2.6, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, BALL_R*0.62, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();

  // serve hint
  if (stuck && state === 'running'){
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(200,210,255,.7)';
    ctx.font = '600 12px Rajdhani, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('LAUNCHING…', W/2, H - 8);
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   2. BACKGROUND FX
   ============================================================ */
#bgCanvas{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-2;pointer-events:none;opacity:.85}
.aurora{
  position:fixed;inset:-20%;z-index:-3;pointer-events:none;
  background:
    radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(124,58,237,.30), transparent 70%) 20% 30%/60% 60% no-repeat,
    radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(34,211,238,.22), transparent 70%) 80% 20%/55% 55% no-repeat,
    radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(244,114,182,.18), transparent 70%) 55% 85%/60% 60% no-repeat;
  filter:blur(30px);
  animation:auroraDrift 22s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}
@keyframes auroraDrift{
  0%{transform:translate3d(0,0,0) scale(1)}
  50%{transform:translate3d(-3%,2%,0) scale(1.08)}
  100%{transform:translate3d(3%,-2%,0) scale(1.03)}
}
body.light .aurora{opacity:.55}

/* ============================================================
   3. PRELOADER
   ============================================================ */
#preloader{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:999;display:grid;place-content:center;justify-items:center;gap:26px;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%, #150a2e, #05010d 70%);
  transition:opacity .6s ease, visibility .6s ease;
}
#preloader.hide{opacity:0;visibility:hidden}
#preloader p{
  font-family:var(--font-head);font-size:.8rem;letter-spacing:.35em;color:#b39dff;
  animation:blink 1.4s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes blink{0%,100%{opacity:.35}50%{opacity:1}}
.loader-ring{
  width:76px;height:76px;border-radius:50%;
  border:3px solid rgba(168,85,247,.18);
  border-top-color:var(--accent2);
  border-right-color:var(--accent);
  animation:spin 1s linear infinite;
  box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(168,85,247,.45);
}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}

/* ============================================================
   4. NAVBAR
   ============================================================ */
.nav{
  position:sticky;top:0;z-index:60;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;
  padding:13px clamp(14px,4vw,48px);
  background:rgba(10,6,26,.62);
  backdrop-filter:blur(18px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
}
body.light .nav{background:rgba(255,255,255,.72)}
.logo{
  font-family:var(--font-head);font-weight:900;font-size:1.05rem;letter-spacing:.12em;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;white-space:nowrap;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#c084fc,#22d3ee);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;
}
.logo span.dot{
  width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--accent2);box-shadow:0 0 14px var(--accent2);
  -webkit-text-fill-color:initial;flex:none;
}
.nav-links{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-left:auto}
.nav-links a{
  padding:9px 15px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;font-size:.9rem;
  letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);
  transition:.25s;border:1px solid transparent;
}
.nav-links a:hover{color:var(--text);background:var(--glass-2);border-color:var(--border)}
.nav-tools{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.icon-btn{
  width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;
  background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--border);cursor:pointer;
  font-size:1.05rem;transition:.25s;color:var(--text);line-height:1;
}
.icon-btn:hover{background:var(--glass-2);transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(168,85,247,.45)}
.icon-btn.off{opacity:.42;filter:grayscale(1)}

/* ============================================================
   5. BUTTONS
   ============================================================ */
.btn{
  border:none;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--font-head);font-weight:700;
  letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.78rem;
  padding:13px 26px;border-radius:999px;color:#fff;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),var(--accent2));
  box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(168,85,247,.36);
  transition:transform .2s ease, box-shadow .25s ease, filter .25s;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.btn::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.35),transparent 55%);
  opacity:0;transition:opacity .25s;
}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 14px 36px rgba(34,211,238,.48)}
.btn:hover::after{opacity:.45}
.btn:active{transform:translateY(0) scale(.97)}
.btn.ghost{
  background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text);box-shadow:none;
}
.btn.ghost:hover{background:var(--glass-2);box-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(168,85,247,.35)}
.btn.big{padding:17px 40px;font-size:.9rem}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed;transform:none!important}

/* ============================================================
   6. HERO
   ============================================================ */
.hero{
  position:relative;text-align:center;
  padding:clamp(52px,9vw,110px) clamp(16px,5vw,60px) clamp(40px,6vw,70px);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:22px;
  overflow:hidden;
}
.hero-glow{
  position:absolute;top:-30%;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  width:min(900px,120vw);height:520px;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(168,85,247,.42), transparent 72%);
  filter:blur(60px);pointer-events:none;animation:heroPulse 6s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}
@keyframes heroPulse{from{opacity:.55;transform:translateX(-50%) scale(.94)}to{opacity:.95;transform:translateX(-50%) scale(1.06)}}
.badge{
  position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;
  padding:9px 20px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;font-size:.74rem;
  letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;
  background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--muted);
  backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
  animation:fadeUp .8s ease both;
}
.hero-title{
  position:relative;font-size:clamp(2.05rem,7.2vw,4.6rem);line-height:1.06;
  font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.02em;max-width:14ch;
  animation:fadeUp .8s .08s ease both;
}
.grad{
  background:linear-gradient(100deg,#c084fc 0%,#22d3ee 45%,#f472b6 90%);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 0 26px rgba(168,85,247,.55));
}
.hero-sub{
  position:relative;font-size:clamp(1rem,2.6vw,1.35rem);font-weight:600;
  letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);
  animation:fadeUp .8s .16s ease both;
}
.hero-actions{position:relative;display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;animation:fadeUp .8s .24s ease both}
.hero-stats{
  position:relative;display:flex;gap:clamp(18px,5vw,54px);flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;
  margin-top:14px;animation:fadeUp .8s .32s ease both;
}
.hero-stats div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px}
.hero-stats b{
  font-family:var(--font-head);font-size:clamp(1.3rem,3.4vw,1.9rem);
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#c084fc,#22d3ee);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;
}
.hero-stats span{font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
@keyframes fadeUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

/* ============================================================
   7. SECTIONS & GAME CARDS
   ============================================================ */
.section{padding:clamp(46px,7vw,86px) clamp(16px,5vw,60px);max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto}
.section-head{text-align:center;margin-bottom:clamp(28px,5vw,52px)}
.section-head h2{
  font-size:clamp(1.5rem,4.4vw,2.5rem);font-weight:800;
  letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;
}
.section-head p{color:var(--muted);margin-top:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700}

.cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(255px,1fr));gap:24px}
.card{
  position:relative;border-radius:var(--radius);padding:28px 24px 24px;
  background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--border);
  backdrop-filter:blur(16px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;overflow:hidden;
  transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1), box-shadow .35s, border-color .35s;
}
.card::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;pointer-events:none;
  background:radial-gradient(420px circle at var(--mx,50%) var(--my,0%), rgba(168,85,247,.22), transparent 60%);
  opacity:0;transition:opacity .35s;
}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-8px);border-color:rgba(34,211,238,.55);box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(124,58,237,.35)}
.card:hover::before{opacity:1}
.card-icon{
  width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:20px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:2rem;
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(168,85,247,.30),rgba(34,211,238,.18));
  border:1px solid var(--border);
  box-shadow:0 0 26px rgba(168,85,247,.35) inset, 0 8px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
  transition:transform .35s;
}
.card:hover .card-icon{transform:rotate(-8deg) scale(1.08)}
.card h3{font-size:1.05rem;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase}
.card p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.98rem;line-height:1.5;font-weight:600;flex:1}
.card-best{
  font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:700;
  color:var(--accent2);font-family:var(--font-head);
}
.card .btn{width:100%;justify-content:center;text-align:center}

/* ============================================================
   8. ABOUT / CONTACT / FOOTER
   ============================================================ */
.about-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:22px}
.about-box{
  background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius);
  padding:26px;backdrop-filter:blur(14px);transition:.3s;
}
.about-box:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:0 18px 44px rgba(124,58,237,.28)}
.about-box h4{font-size:.9rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:10px;color:var(--accent2)}
.about-box p{color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;line-height:1.6;font-size:.98rem}

.contact-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:26px;align-items:start}
.form-card{
  background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius);
  padding:clamp(22px,4vw,34px);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;
}
.field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px}
.field label{font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700}
.field input,.field textarea{
  font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:1rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);
  background:var(--glass-2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;
  padding:13px 16px;outline:none;transition:.25s;resize:vertical;
}
.field input:focus,.field textarea:focus{border-color:var(--accent2);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(34,211,238,.18)}
.field textarea{min-height:110px}
.contact-info{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px}
.info-row{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:18px;padding:18px 20px}
.info-row .em{font-size:1.5rem}
.info-row b{display:block;font-family:var(--font-head);font-size:.82rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}
.info-row span{color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;font-size:.92rem}

footer{
  border-top:1px solid var(--border);margin-top:30px;
  padding:34px clamp(16px,5vw,60px);
  display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;font-size:.88rem;letter-spacing:.06em;
  background:rgba(10,6,26,.45);
}
body.light footer{background:rgba(255,255,255,.55)}
footer .f-logo{font-family:var(--font-head);color:var(--text);letter-spacing:.14em;font-size:.85rem}

/* ============================================================
   9. OVERLAY / GAME PANELS
   ============================================================ */
#gameOverlay{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:120;display:none;overflow-y:auto;
  background:rgba(4,2,12,.94);
  backdrop-filter:blur(18px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px);
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;
}
body.light #gameOverlay{background:rgba(236,240,255,.96)}
#gameOverlay.open{display:block;animation:fadeIn .3s ease}
@keyframes fadeIn{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
.overlay-inner{min-height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.overlay-head{
  position:sticky;top:0;z-index:6;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;
  padding:13px clamp(12px,3.4vw,34px);
  background:rgba(10,6,26,.88);
  backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
}
body.light .overlay-head{background:rgba(255,255,255,.9)}
.overlay-head h2{
  flex:1;text-align:center;font-size:clamp(.85rem,2.6vw,1.15rem);
  letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;min-width:120px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#c084fc,#22d3ee);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;
}
.panel-wrap{flex:1;display:flex;justify-content:center;padding:clamp(16px,3.6vw,40px) clamp(12px,3.4vw,34px) 60px}
.game-panel{display:none;width:100%;max-width:820px}
.game-panel.active{display:block;animation:pop .38s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.2)}
@keyframes pop{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.95) translateY(14px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

/* instructions */
.instr{
  display:none;margin-bottom:18px;padding:18px 20px;border-radius:18px;
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(168,85,247,.16),rgba(34,211,238,.08));
  border:1px solid var(--border);
}
.instr.show{display:block;animation:pop .3s ease}
.instr h4{font-size:.74rem;letter-spacing:.22em;color:var(--accent2);margin-bottom:8px}
.instr p{color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;line-height:1.6;font-size:.96rem}
.instr b{color:var(--text)}

/* HUD */
.hud{
  display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:18px;
}
.stat{
  flex:1 1 96px;max-width:180px;text-align:center;
  background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:16px;
  padding:11px 14px;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
}
.stat span{display:block;font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:3px}
.stat b{font-family:var(--font-head);font-size:1.18rem;color:var(--text);letter-spacing:.04em}
.stat b.hl{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#c084fc,#22d3ee);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}

/* stage */
.stage{
  position:relative;width:100%;max-width:460px;margin:0 auto;
  border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;
  border:1px solid var(--border);
  box-shadow:0 0 46px rgba(124,58,237,.32), inset 0 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
  background:#08041a;
}
.stage canvas{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;touch-action:none}
.stage-overlay{
  position:absolute;inset:0;display:none;place-content:center;justify-items:center;gap:10px;
  text-align:center;padding:20px;
  background:rgba(6,2,18,.86);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);z-index:3;
}
.stage-overlay.show{display:grid;animation:fadeIn .25s ease}
.stage-overlay h3{
  font-size:clamp(1.05rem,4vw,1.5rem);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#c084fc,#22d3ee);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;
}
.stage-overlay p{color:#b9c2e0;font-weight:600;font-size:.9rem;max-width:34ch;line-height:1.5}

/* control rows */
.controls{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;margin-top:18px}
.controls .btn{flex:0 1 auto}

/* ============================================================
   10. GAME-SPECIFIC STYLES
   ============================================================ */
/* Tic Tac Toe */
.ttt-board{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;
  width:min(100%,360px);margin:0 auto;
}
.ttt-cell{
  aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:18px;cursor:pointer;
  background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--border);
  display:grid;place-items:center;
  font-family:var(--font-head);font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(34px,10vw,54px);
  color:var(--text);transition:.22s;user-select:none;
}
.ttt-cell:hover:not(.taken){background:var(--glass-2);transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(124,58,237,.35)}
.ttt-cell.x{color:#22d3ee;text-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(34,211,238,.75)}
.ttt-cell.o{color:#f472b6;text-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(244,114,182,.75)}
.ttt-cell.taken{cursor:not-allowed}
.ttt-cell.win{
  background:rgba(168,85,247,.28);border-color:var(--accent);
  animation:winPulse .8s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}
@keyframes winPulse{from{box-shadow:0 0 0 rgba(168,85,247,.5)}to{box-shadow:0 0 34px rgba(168,85,247,.95)}}
#tttStatus{
  text-align:center;margin-top:20px;font-family:var(--font-head);
  font-size:clamp(.8rem,2.6vw,1rem);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--accent2);min-height:1.4em;
}

/* RPS */
.rps-arena{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:clamp(10px,4vw,34px);
  margin-bottom:18px;
}
.rps-side{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex:1;max-width:180px}
.rps-hand{
  width:100%;aspect-ratio:1;max-width:130px;border-radius:24px;
  display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:clamp(2.4rem,9vw,3.4rem);
  background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--border);
  box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(124,58,237,.3) inset;
  transition:transform .18s;
}
.rps-hand.shake{animation:shake .35s ease}
@keyframes shake{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0)}25%{transform:translateY(-12px) rotate(-9deg)}75%{transform:translateY(-12px) rotate(9deg)}}
.rps-side span{font-size:.66rem;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700}
.rps-vs{font-family:var(--font-head);font-weight:900;font-size:1rem;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.1em}
#rpsResult{
  text-align:center;font-family:var(--font-head);font-size:clamp(.9rem,3vw,1.15rem);
  letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:20px;min-height:1.5em;
  transition:color .3s;
}
#rpsResult.win{color:#4ade80;text-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(74,222,128,.7)}
#rpsResult.lose{color:#fb7185;text-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(251,113,133,.7)}
#rpsResult.draw{color:#facc15;text-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(250,204,21,.7)}
.rps-choices{display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:18px}
.rps-btn{
  flex:1 1 96px;max-width:150px;cursor:pointer;
  background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:20px;
  padding:16px 10px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px;
  color:var(--text);font-family:var(--font-head);font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.14em;
  transition:.22s;text-transform:uppercase;
}
.rps-btn .em{font-size:1.9rem;line-height:1}
.rps-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:var(--accent2);box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(34,211,238,.32);background:var(--glass-2)}
.rps-btn:active{transform:scale(.96)}

/* Memory */
.memory-grid{
  display:grid;gap:10px;width:100%;max-width:560px;margin:0 auto;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(var(--cols,4),1fr);
}
.mcard{aspect-ratio:3/4;perspective:800px;cursor:pointer;background:none;border:none;padding:0}
.mcard-inner{
  position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;transform-style:preserve-3d;
  transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.3,.9,.3,1.1);
}
.mcard.flipped .mcard-inner,.mcard.matched .mcard-inner{transform:rotateY(180deg)}
.mface{
  position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:14px;display:grid;place-items:center;
  backface-visibility:hidden;-webkit-backface-visibility:hidden;
  font-size:clamp(18px,5vw,30px);user-select:none;
}
.mfront{
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,#2b1354,#0d0620);
  border:1px solid rgba(150,120,255,.35);
  color:#a78bfa;font-family:var(--font-head);font-weight:900;
  box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.45), inset 0 0 22px rgba(124,58,237,.28);
}
body.light .mfront{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#c7b8ff,#e9e3ff);color:#6d3fd6}
.mback{
  transform:rotateY(180deg);
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,#3b1e6e,#180a34);
  border:1px solid rgba(34,211,238,.45);
  box-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(34,211,238,.35);
}
body.light .mback{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#ffffff,#dfe8ff)}
.mcard.matched .mback{border-color:#4ade80;box-shadow:0 0 26px rgba(74,222,128,.6);animation:matchedPop .45s ease}
@keyframes matchedPop{0%{transform:scale(1)}45%{transform:scale(1.12)}100%{transform:scale(1)}}
.level-row{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:18px}
.lvl{
  padding:9px 18px;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--font-head);
  font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;
  background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--muted);transition:.22s;
}
.lvl:hover{color:var(--text);background:var(--glass-2)}
.lvl.active{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),var(--accent2));color:#fff;border-color:transparent;box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(168,85,247,.4)}

/* Whack-a-mole */
.mole-grid{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:clamp(8px,2.5vw,16px);
  width:100%;max-width:440px;margin:0 auto;
}
.hole{
  position:relative;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 32%, #1d1136 0%, #0a0518 70%);
  border:2px solid rgba(150,120,255,.25);
  box-shadow:inset 0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.85), 0 0 0 rgba(34,211,238,0);
  transition:box-shadow .25s, border-color .25s;
}
.hole.up{border-color:rgba(34,211,238,.55);box-shadow:inset 0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.8), 0 0 24px rgba(34,211,238,.45)}
.mole{
  position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;
  font-size:clamp(26px,7vw,44px);
  transform:translateY(115%);transition:transform .13s cubic-bezier(.3,1.4,.5,1);
  user-select:none;pointer-events:none;
}
.hole.up .mole{transform:translateY(6%)}
.hole.bonk .mole{transform:translateY(115%) scale(.55);transition:transform .12s ease-in}
.hole.bonk{animation:bonkFlash .25s ease}
@keyframes bonkFlash{0%{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 32%, #4c1d95, #0a0518 70%)}100%{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 32%, #1d1136, #0a0518 70%)}}
.pop-text{
  position:absolute;top:12%;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  font-family:var(--font-head);font-weight:900;font-size:.95rem;color:#4ade80;
  text-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(74,222,128,.9);pointer-events:none;
  animation:floatUp .65s ease forwards;z-index:4;
}
@keyframes floatUp{from{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}to{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-42px)}}
.timer-bar{
  height:8px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--border);
  overflow:hidden;max-width:440px;margin:0 auto 18px;
}
.timer-fill{
  height:100%;width:100%;border-radius:99px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#22d3ee,#a855f7,#f472b6);
  transition:width .25s linear;
}

/* toast */
#toast{
  position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:34px;transform:translate(-50%,140%);
  z-index:400;padding:14px 26px;border-radius:999px;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),var(--accent2));
  color:#fff;font-family:var(--font-head);font-size:.76rem;letter-spacing:.14em;
  text-transform:uppercase;box-shadow:0 14px 40px rgba(168,85,247,.55);
  transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.3);white-space:nowrap;
}
#toast.show{transform:translate(-50%,0)}

/* ============================================================
   11. RESPONSIVE
   ============================================================ */
@media (max-width:820px){
  .nav{padding:11px 14px;gap:10px}
  .nav-links{order:3;width:100%;justify-content:center;margin-left:0}
  .nav-tools{margin-left:auto}
  .logo{font-size:.92rem}
}
@media (max-width:560px){
  .hero-stats{gap:22px}
  .overlay-head h2{order:-1;width:100%;text-align:center}
  .overlay-head .btn{padding:10px 16px;font-size:.68rem}
  .controls .btn{padding:11px 18px;font-size:.7rem}
  .rps-hand{max-width:100px}
  .stat{flex:1 1 70px;padding:9px 8px}
  .stat b{font-size:1rem}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  *,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.001ms!important;transition-duration:.001ms!important}
}
</style>
</head>

<script>
/* ============================================================
   0. HELPERS
   ============================================================ */
const $  = (s, r = document) => r.querySelector(s);
const $$ = (s, r = document) => Array.from(r.querySelectorAll(s));
const clamp = (v, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v));
const randInt = n => Math.floor(Math.random() * n);
const store = {
  get(k, fallback) {
    try { const v = localStorage.getItem(k); return v === null ? fallback : JSON.parse(v); }
    catch (e) { return fallback; }
  },
  set(k, v) { try { localStorage.setItem(k, JSON.stringify(v)); } catch (e) {} }
};
function roundRect(c, x, y, w, h, r) {
  if (typeof c.roundRect === 'function') { c.beginPath(); c.roundRect(x, y, w, h, r); return; }
  c.beginPath();
  c.moveTo(x + r, y);
  c.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  c.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  c.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  c.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  c.closePath();
}
let toastTimer = null;
function toast(msg) {
  const t = $('#toast');
  t.textContent = msg;
  t.classList.add('show');
  clearTimeout(toastTimer);
  toastTimer = setTimeout(() => t.classList.remove('show'), 2200);
}

/* ============================================================
   1. SOUND ENGINE (Web Audio — no external files)
   ============================================================ */
const Sound = (function () {
  let ctx = null;
  let sfxOn = store.get('gz_sfx', true);
  let musicOn = false;
  let musicTimer = null;
  let musicStep = 0;

  function ac() {
    if (!ctx) {
      const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
      if (!AC) return null;
      ctx = new AC();
    }
    if (ctx.state === 'suspended') ctx.resume();
    return ctx;
  }

  function tone(freq, dur = 0.1, type = 'sine', vol = 0.11, when = 0, slideTo = null) {
    const c = ac();
    if (!c) return;
    const t0 = c.currentTime + when;
    const osc = c.createOscillator();
    const g = c.createGain();
    osc.type = type;
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t0);
    if (slideTo) osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(slideTo, t0 + dur);
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t0);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vol, t0 + 0.012);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0 + dur);
    osc.connect(g).connect(c.destination);
    osc.start(t0);
    osc.stop(t0 + dur + 0.03);
  }

  function play(name) {
    if (!sfxOn) return;
    switch (name) {
      case 'click':  tone(520, 0.06, 'square', 0.05); break;
      case 'start':  tone(440, 0.09, 'triangle', 0.09, 0, 660); break;
      case 'eat':    tone(660, 0.08, 'square', 0.08, 0, 990); break;
      case 'flip':   tone(380, 0.07, 'sine', 0.08, 0, 520); break;
      case 'match':  tone(660, 0.1, 'sine', 0.1, 0); tone(880, 0.14, 'sine', 0.09, 0.09); break;
      case 'miss':   tone(220, 0.16, 'sawtooth', 0.06, 0, 140); break;
      case 'bonk':   tone(300, 0.07, 'square', 0.09, 0, 180); break;
      case 'win':    [523, 659, 784, 1046].forEach((f, i) => tone(f, 0.2, 'triangle', 0.1, i * 0.1)); break;
      case 'lose':   [392, 330, 262, 196].forEach((f, i) => tone(f, 0.22, 'sawtooth', 0.07, i * 0.11)); break;
      case 'draw':   tone(440, 0.14, 'triangle', 0.08); tone(440, 0.14, 'triangle', 0.08, 0.16); break;
      case 'tick':   tone(880, 0.05, 'square', 0.04); break;
    }
  }

  const SCALE = [220.00, 261.63, 293.66, 329.63, 392.00, 440.00, 523.25, 587.33];
  function musicTick() {
    if (!musicOn) return;
    const f = SCALE[musicStep % SCALE.length];
    tone(f, 1.1, 'triangle', 0.035);
    tone(f / 2, 1.5, 'sine', 0.026);
    if (musicStep % 4 === 0) tone(f * 2, 0.6, 'sine', 0.018);
    musicStep++;
    musicTimer = setTimeout(musicTick, 470);
  }
  function startMusic() { if (musicOn) return; musicOn = true; musicStep = 0; musicTick(); }
  function stopMusic() { musicOn = false; clearTimeout(musicTimer); }

  return {
    play,
    isSfxOn: () => sfxOn,
    setSfx(v) { sfxOn = v; store.set('gz_sfx', v); },
    isMusicOn: () => musicOn,
    toggleMusic() { musicOn ? stopMusic() : startMusic(); return musicOn; },
    stopMusic
  };
})();

/* ============================================================
   2. BACKGROUND PARTICLES
   ============================================================ */
(function backgroundFX() {
  const canvas = $('#bgCanvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let w = 0, h = 0, dpr = 1, parts = [];

  function makeSprite(hue) {
    const s = document.createElement('canvas');
    s.width = s.height = 64;
    const c = s.getContext('2d');
    const g = c.createRadialGradient(32, 32, 0, 32, 32, 32);
    g.addColorStop(0, `hsla(${hue},100%,78%,1)`);
    g.addColorStop(0.35, `hsla(${hue},100%,68%,0.45)`);
    g.addColorStop(1, `hsla(${hue},100%,68%,0)`);
    c.fillStyle = g;
    c.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64);
    return s;
  }
  const SPRITES = [makeSprite(275), makeSprite(190), makeSprite(320)];

  function resize() {
    dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    w = canvas.width = Math.floor(innerWidth * dpr);
    h = canvas.height = Math.floor(innerHeight * dpr);
    canvas.style.width = innerWidth + 'px';
    canvas.style.height = innerHeight + 'px';
    const count = clamp(Math.floor((innerWidth * innerHeight) / 20000), 30, 85);
    parts = Array.from({ length: count }, () => ({
      x: Math.random() * w,
      y: Math.random() * h,
      r: (Math.random() * 16 + 8) * dpr,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.28 * dpr,
      vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.28 * dpr,
      a: Math.random() * 0.45 + 0.2,
      s: SPRITES[randInt(SPRITES.length)]
    }));
  }

  function loop() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    for (const p of parts) {
      p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy;
      if (p.x < -60) p.x = w + 60;
      if (p.x > w + 60) p.x = -60;
      if (p.y < -60) p.y = h + 60;
      if (p.y > h + 60) p.y = -60;
      ctx.globalAlpha = p.a;
      ctx.drawImage(p.s, p.x - p.r, p.y - p.r, p.r * 2, p.r * 2);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  addEventListener('resize', resize, { passive: true });
  resize();
  loop();
})();

(function uiControls() {

  const soundBtn = $('#soundBtn');
  const musicBtn = $('#musicBtn');

  function applyTheme(light) {
    document.body.classList.toggle('light', light);
    themeBtn.textContent = light ? '☀️' : '🌙';
    store.set('gz_theme', light ? 'light' : 'dark');
  }
  applyTheme(store.get('gz_theme', 'dark') === 'light');

  themeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    applyTheme(!document.body.classList.contains('light'));
    Sound.play('click');
  });

  function paintSound() { soundBtn.textContent = Sound.isSfxOn() ? '🔊' : '🔇'; soundBtn.classList.toggle('off', !Sound.isSfxOn()); }
  paintSound();
  soundBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    Sound.setSfx(!Sound.isSfxOn());
    paintSound();
    Sound.play('click');
  });

  function paintMusic() { musicBtn.classList.toggle('off', !Sound.isMusicOn()); }
  paintMusic();
  musicBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    Sound.toggleMusic();
    paintMusic();
    if (Sound.isMusicOn()) toast('Music On');
    else toast('Music Off');
  });

  document.addEventListener('click', e => {

  }, true);
})();

/* ============================================================
   5. OVERLAY CONTROLLER
   ============================================================ */
const HUB = (function () {
  const overlay = $('#gameOverlay');
  const titleEl = $('#gameTitle');
  const panels = $$('.game-panel');
  let current = null;

  const META = {
    breakout: { title: 'NEON BREAKOUT',      api: () => Breakout },
    ttt:      { title: 'TIC-TAC-TOE',        api: () => TTT },
    rps:      { title: 'ROCK PAPER SCISSORS',api: () => RPS },
    memory:   { title: 'MEMORY MATCH',       api: () => Memory },
    whack:    { title: 'WHACK-A-MOLE',       api: () => Whack }
  };

  function open(id) {
    if (!META[id]) return;
    if (current && META[current].api().leave) META[current].api().leave();
    current = id;
    panels.forEach(p => p.classList.toggle('active', p.id === 'panel-' + id));
    titleEl.textContent = META[id].title;
    $$('.instr').forEach(i => i.classList.remove('show'));
    overlay.classList.add('open');
    document.body.classList.add('no-scroll');
    overlay.scrollTop = 0;
    const api = META[id].api();
    if (api.enter) api.enter();
    Sound.play('start');
  }

  function close() {
    if (current && META[current].api().leave) META[current].api().leave();
    current = null;
    overlay.classList.remove('open');
    document.body.classList.remove('no-scroll');
    refreshCardBests();
  }

  $('#backHome').addEventListener('click', () => {
    close();
    document.getElementById('games').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  });

  $('#instrBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (!current) return;
    const box = $('#instr-' + current);
    if (box) box.classList.toggle('show');
  });

  addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && current) close();
  });

  return { open, close, getCurrent: () => current };
})();

function isPanelActive(id) {
  const p = document.getElementById('panel-' + id);
  return !!p && p.classList.contains('active');
}

$$('[data-game]').forEach(btn => {
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => HUB.open(btn.dataset.game));
});

/* ============================================================
   6. NEON BREAKOUT  (replaces the old Snake game)
   ============================================================ */
const Breakout = (function () {
  const canvas = $('#breakoutCanvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = 480, H = 360;
  canvas.width = W;
  canvas.height = H;

  const elScore = $('#boScore');
  const elBest  = $('#boBest');
  const elLives = $('#boLives');
  const elLevel = $('#boLevel');
  const overlay = $('#boOverlay');
  const ovTitle = $('#boOverlayTitle');
  const ovText  = $('#boOverlayText');
  const ovBtn   = $('#boAction');
  const btnPause = $('#boPause');

  /* geometry */
  const PADDLE_W = 88, PADDLE_H = 12, PADDLE_Y = H - 28;
  const BALL_R = 7;
  const PAD_X = 26, TOP_Y = 46, BRICK_H = 18, GAP = 6, COLS = 8;

  let best = store.get('gz_breakout_best', 0) || 0;
  elBest.textContent = best;

  let paddle = { x: W / 2 - PADDLE_W / 2, w: PADDLE_W };
  let ball   = { x: W / 2, y: PADDLE_Y - BALL_R - 1, vx: 0, vy: 0 };
  let speed  = 250;
  let bricks = [];
  let score = 0, lives = 3, level = 1;
  let state = 'idle';            // idle | running | paused | over
  let stuck = true, serveDelay = 0;
  let left = false, right = false;
  let raf = null, lastT = 0;

  /* ---------- setup ---------- */
  function buildBricks() {
    bricks = [];
    const bw = (W - PAD_X * 2 - GAP * (COLS - 1)) / COLS;
    const rows = Math.min(4 + level, 8);
    for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
      for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
        bricks.push({
          x: PAD_X + c * (bw + GAP),
          y: TOP_Y + r * (BRICK_H + GAP),
          w: bw, h: BRICK_H,
          hue: 275 - r * 16,
          alive: true
        });
      }
    }
  }

  function stickBall() {
    ball.x = clamp(paddle.x + paddle.w / 2, BALL_R, W - BALL_R);
    ball.y = PADDLE_Y - BALL_R - 1;
  }

  function resetBall(delay) {
    stuck = true;
    serveDelay = delay === undefined ? 0.9 : delay;
    ball.vx = 0;
    ball.vy = 0;
    stickBall();
  }

  function launch() {
    stuck = false;
    const a = (Math.random() * 0.9 - 0.45) * (Math.PI / 2); // ±40° from vertical
    ball.vx = speed * Math.sin(a);
    ball.vy = -speed * Math.cos(a);
    Sound.play('flip');
  }

  function newGame() {
    score = 0;
    lives = 3;
    level = 1;
    speed = 250;
    paddle.x = W / 2 - PADDLE_W / 2;
    elScore.textContent = '0';
    elLives.textContent = '3';
    elLevel.textContent = '1';
    buildBricks();
    resetBall(0.9);
    state = 'idle';
    btnPause.textContent = 'PAUSE';
  }

  /* ---------- flow ---------- */
  function showOverlay(title, text, btnLabel) {
    ovTitle.textContent = title;
    ovText.textContent = text;
    ovBtn.textContent = btnLabel;
    overlay.classList.add('show');
  }
  function hideOverlay() { overlay.classList.remove('show'); }

  function startGame() {
    if (state === 'running') return;
    if (state === 'over' || state === 'idle') {
      if (state === 'over') newGame();
      state = 'running';
      hideOverlay();
      btnPause.textContent = 'PAUSE';
      lastT = 0;
      if (!raf) raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      Sound.play('start');
    }
  }

  function togglePause() {
    if (state === 'running') {
      state = 'paused';
      btnPause.textContent = 'RESUME';
      showOverlay('PAUSED', 'Take a breath — your run is safe.', 'RESUME');
    } else if (state === 'paused') {
      state = 'running';
      hideOverlay();
      btnPause.textContent = 'PAUSE';
      lastT = 0;
    }
  }

  function gameOver() {
    state = 'over';
    btnPause.textContent = 'PAUSE';
    if (score > best) {
      best = score;
      store.set('gz_breakout_best', best);
      elBest.textContent = best;
    }
    Sound.play('lose');
    showOverlay('GAME OVER', `You scored ${score} point${score === 1 ? '' : 's'} and reached level ${level}. Best: ${best}.`, 'PLAY AGAIN');
  }

  function loseLife() {
    lives--;
    elLives.textContent = Math.max(0, lives);
    Sound.play('miss');
    if (lives <= 0) { gameOver(); return; }
    resetBall(1.0);
  }

  function nextLevel() {
    level++;
    elLevel.textContent = level;
    speed = Math.min(250 + (level - 1) * 28, 430);
    buildBricks();
    resetBall(1.0);
    Sound.play('win');
    toast('Level ' + level + '!');
  }

  /* ---------- physics ---------- */
  function collide() {
    /* walls */
    if (ball.x - BALL_R < 0) { ball.x = BALL_R; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); Sound.play('click'); }
    if (ball.x + BALL_R > W) { ball.x = W - BALL_R; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); Sound.play('click'); }
    if (ball.y - BALL_R < 0) { ball.y = BALL_R; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); Sound.play('click'); }

    /* paddle */
    if (ball.vy > 0 &&
        ball.y + BALL_R >= PADDLE_Y &&
        ball.y - BALL_R <= PADDLE_Y + PADDLE_H &&
        ball.x >= paddle.x - BALL_R &&
        ball.x <= paddle.x + paddle.w + BALL_R) {
      const hit = clamp((ball.x - (paddle.x + paddle.w / 2)) / (paddle.w / 2), -1, 1);
      const ang = hit * 1.0;                       // up to ~57°
      const sp = Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy) || speed;
      ball.vx = sp * Math.sin(ang);
      ball.vy = -Math.abs(sp * Math.cos(ang));
      ball.y = PADDLE_Y - BALL_R - 0.5;
      Sound.play('bonk');
    }

    /* bricks */
    for (const b of bricks) {
      if (!b.alive) continue;
      const cx = clamp(ball.x, b.x, b.x + b.w);
      const cy = clamp(ball.y, b.y, b.y + b.h);
      const dx = ball.x - cx, dy = ball.y - cy;
      if (dx * dx + dy * dy > BALL_R * BALL_R) continue;

      const ox = (b.w / 2 + BALL_R) - Math.abs(ball.x - (b.x + b.w / 2));
      const oy = (b.h / 2 + BALL_R) - Math.abs(ball.y - (b.y + b.h / 2));
      if (ox < oy) {
        ball.vx = -ball.vx;
        ball.x += ball.x < b.x + b.w / 2 ? -ox : ox;
      } else {
        ball.vy = -ball.vy;
        ball.y += ball.y < b.y + b.h / 2 ? -oy : oy;
      }

      b.alive = false;
      score += 10;
      elScore.textContent = score;
      if (score > best) {
        best = score;
        store.set('gz_breakout_best', best);
        elBest.textContent = best;
      }
      Sound.play('eat');

      const sp = Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy);
      if (sp > 0) {
        const ns = Math.min(sp + 3, 480);
        ball.vx *= ns / sp;
        ball.vy *= ns / sp;
      }
      break; // one brick per sub-step
    }

    /* board cleared */
    if (bricks.every(b => !b.alive)) { nextLevel(); return; }

    /* fell off the bottom */
    if (ball.y - BALL_R > H) { loseLife(); }
  }

  function update(dt) {
    if (left)  paddle.x -= 420 * dt;
    if (right) paddle.x += 420 * dt;
    paddle.x = clamp(paddle.x, 0, W - paddle.w);

    if (stuck) {
      stickBall();
      serveDelay -= dt;
      if (serveDelay <= 0) launch();
      return;
    }

    const dist = Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy) * dt;
    const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(dist / 4));
    const sdt = dt / steps;

    for (let s = 0; s < steps; s++) {
      ball.x += ball.vx * sdt;
      ball.y += ball.vy * sdt;
      collide();
      if (state !== 'running' || stuck) return;
    }
  }

  /* ---------- render ---------- */
  function draw() {
    const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    bg.addColorStop(0, '#0d0622');
    bg.addColorStop(1, '#050210');
    ctx.fillStyle = bg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(150,120,255,.06)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (let x = 0; x < W; x += 40) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, 0); ctx.lineTo(x, H); ctx.stroke(); }
    for (let y = 0; y < H; y += 40) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y); ctx.lineTo(W, y); ctx.stroke(); }

    /* bricks */
    for (const b of bricks) {
      if (!b.alive) continue;
      const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(b.x, b.y, b.x, b.y + b.h);
      g.addColorStop(0, `hsl(${b.hue},92%,68%)`);
      g.addColorStop(1, `hsl(${b.hue - 22},86%,46%)`);
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.shadowColor = `hsla(${b.hue},100%,66%,.85)`;
      ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
      roundRect(ctx, b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 5);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

    /* paddle */
    const pg = ctx.createLinearGradient(paddle.x, 0, paddle.x + paddle.w, 0);
    pg.addColorStop(0, '#22d3ee');
    pg.addColorStop(0.5, '#8b5cf6');
    pg.addColorStop(1, '#f472b6');
    ctx.fillStyle = pg;
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(34,211,238,.9)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 18;
    roundRect(ctx, paddle.x, PADDLE_Y, paddle.w, PADDLE_H, 6);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

    /* ball */
    const halo = ctx.createRadialGradient(ball.x, ball.y, 0, ball.x, ball.y, BALL_R * 2.8);
    halo.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,.95)');
    halo.addColorStop(0.4, 'rgba(196,181,253,.75)');
    halo.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(168,85,247,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = halo;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, BALL_R * 2.8, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, BALL_R * 0.66, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

    /* serve hint */
    if (stuck && state === 'running') {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(200,210,255,.7)';
      ctx.font = '700 11px Rajdhani, sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText('LAUNCHING…', W / 2, H - 8);
    }
  }

  function frame(t) {
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    const dt = lastT ? Math.min((t - lastT) / 1000, 0.05) : 0;
    lastT = t;
    if (state === 'running') update(dt);
    else if (stuck && state !== 'over') stickBall();
    draw();
  }

  /* ---------- input ---------- */
  function pointerToPaddle(e) {
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!r.width) return;
    const x = (e.clientX - r.left) * (W / r.width);
    paddle.x = clamp(x - paddle.w / 2, 0, W - paddle.w);
    if (stuck) stickBall();
  }
  canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', pointerToPaddle);
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', pointerToPaddle);

  addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (!isPanelActive('panel-breakout')) return;
    const k = e.key;
    if (k === 'ArrowLeft' || k === 'a' || k === 'A') { left = true; e.preventDefault(); }
    else if (k === 'ArrowRight' || k === 'd' || k === 'D') { right = true; e.preventDefault(); }
    else if (k === ' ' || k === 'p' || k === 'P') { togglePause(); e.preventDefault(); }
  });
  addEventListener('keyup', e => {
    const k = e.key;
    if (k === 'ArrowLeft' || k === 'a' || k === 'A') left = false;
    if (k === 'ArrowRight' || k === 'd' || k === 'D') right = false;
  });

  ovBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (state === 'over') { newGame(); startGame(); }
    else if (state === 'paused') togglePause();
    else startGame();
  });
  btnPause.addEventListener('click', togglePause);
  $('#boRestart').addEventListener('click', () => {
    newGame();
    startGame();
  });

  /* ---------- lifecycle ---------- */
  return {
    enter() {
      newGame();
      showOverlay('READY?', 'Move the paddle with your mouse, finger or arrow keys. Clear every brick!', 'START');
      left = right = false;
      lastT = 0;
      if (!raf) raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    },
    leave() {
      state = 'idle';
      stuck = true;
      left = right = false;
      if (raf) { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = null; }
    },
    newGame
  };
})();

/* ============================================================
   7. TIC-TAC-TOE
   ============================================================ */
const TTT = (function () {
  const WIN_LINES = [
    [0,1,2],[3,4,5],[6,7,8],
    [0,3,6],[1,4,7],[2,5,8],
    [0,4,8],[2,4,6]
  ];
  const boardEl = $('#tttBoard');
  const statusEl = $('#tttStatus');
  const elX = $('#tttScoreX'), elO = $('#tttScoreO'), elD = $('#tttScoreD');

  let board = Array(9).fill('');
  let turn = 'X';
  let locked = false;
  let scores = store.get('gz_ttt', { x: 0, o: 0, d: 0 });

  function paintScores() {
    elX.textContent = scores.x;
    elO.textContent = scores.o;
    elD.textContent = scores.d;
    store.set('gz_ttt', scores);
  }

  function build() {
    boardEl.innerHTML = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
      const cell = document.createElement('button');
      cell.className = 'ttt-cell';
      cell.dataset.i = i;
      cell.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Cell ' + (i + 1));
      cell.addEventListener('click', () => move(i));
      boardEl.appendChild(cell);
    }
  }

  function render() {
    $$('.ttt-cell', boardEl).forEach((c, i) => {
      c.textContent = board[i];
      c.classList.toggle('x', board[i] === 'X');
      c.classList.toggle('o', board[i] === 'O');
      c.classList.toggle('taken', board[i] !== '');
      c.classList.remove('win');
    });
  }

  function checkWinner() {
    for (const line of WIN_LINES) {
      const [a, b, c] = line;
      if (board[a] && board[a] === board[b] && board[a] === board[c]) {
        return { winner: board[a], line };
      }
    }
    if (board.every(v => v !== '')) return { winner: 'draw', line: [] };
    return null;
  }

  function move(i) {
    if (locked || board[i] !== '') return;
    board[i] = turn;
    Sound.play('flip');
    render();

    const result = checkWinner();
    if (result) {
      locked = true;
      if (result.winner === 'draw') {
        scores.d++;
        statusEl.textContent = "It's a draw!";
        Sound.play('draw');
      } else {
        if (result.winner === 'X') scores.x++; else scores.o++;
        result.line.forEach(idx => $$('.ttt-cell', boardEl)[idx].classList.add('win'));
        statusEl.textContent = `Player ${result.winner} wins! 🎉`;
        Sound.play('win');
      }
      paintScores();
      return;
    }

    turn = turn === 'X' ? 'O' : 'X';
    statusEl.textContent = `Player ${turn}'s turn`;
  }

  function newRound() {
    board = Array(9).fill('');
    turn = 'X';
    locked = false;
    render();
    statusEl.textContent = "Player X's turn";
  }

  $('#tttRestart').addEventListener('click', () => { newRound(); Sound.play('click'); });
  $('#tttResetScores').addEventListener('click', () => {
    scores = { x: 0, o: 0, d: 0 };
    paintScores();
    newRound();
    toast('Scores reset');
  });

  build();
  paintScores();
  newRound();

  return { enter() { newRound(); paintScores(); }, leave() {} };
})();

/* ============================================================
   8. ROCK PAPER SCISSORS
   ============================================================ */
const RPS = (function () {
  const MOVES = ['rock', 'paper', 'scissors'];
  const EMOJI = { rock: '✊', paper: '✋', scissors: '✌️' };
  const BEATS = { rock: 'scissors', paper: 'rock', scissors: 'paper' };
  const COUNTER = { rock: 'paper', paper: 'scissors', scissors: 'rock' };

  const playerHand = $('#rpsPlayerHand');
  const cpuHand = $('#rpsCpuHand');
  const resultEl = $('#rpsResult');
  const elW = $('#rpsWins'), elL = $('#rpsLosses'), elD = $('#rpsDraws');

  let stats = store.get('gz_rps', { w: 0, l: 0, d: 0 });
  let history = [];
  let busy = false;

  function paint() {
    elW.textContent = stats.w;
    elL.textContent = stats.l;
    elD.textContent = stats.d;
    store.set('gz_rps', stats);
  }

  function cpuPick() {
    if (history.length >= 3 && Math.random() < 0.55) {
      const counts = { rock: 0, paper: 0, scissors: 0 };
      history.slice(-12).forEach(m => counts[m]++);
      const most = MOVES.reduce((a, b) => (counts[b] > counts[a] ? b : a), 'rock');
      return COUNTER[most];
    }
    return MOVES[randInt(3)];
  }

  function play(playerMove) {
    if (busy) return;
    busy = true;

    const cpuMove = cpuPick();
    history.push(playerMove);

    playerHand.textContent = '❔';
    cpuHand.textContent = '❔';
    resultEl.textContent = 'Choosing…';
    resultEl.className = '';
    playerHand.classList.add('shake');
    cpuHand.classList.add('shake');
    Sound.play('flip');

    setTimeout(() => {
      playerHand.classList.remove('shake');
      cpuHand.classList.remove('shake');
      playerHand.textContent = EMOJI[playerMove];
      cpuHand.textContent = EMOJI[cpuMove];

      if (playerMove === cpuMove) {
        stats.d++;
        resultEl.textContent = "It's a draw!";
        resultEl.className = 'draw';
        Sound.play('draw');
      } else if (BEATS[playerMove] === cpuMove) {
        stats.w++;
        resultEl.textContent = 'You win! 🎉';
        resultEl.className = 'win';
        Sound.play('win');
      } else {
        stats.l++;
        resultEl.textContent = 'CPU wins! 😈';
        resultEl.className = 'lose';
        Sound.play('lose');
      }
      paint();
      busy = false;
    }, 380);
  }

  $$('.rps-btn').forEach(b => b.addEventListener('click', () => play(b.dataset.move)));

  $('#rpsReset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    stats = { w: 0, l: 0, d: 0 };
    history = [];
    paint();
    playerHand.textContent = '❔';
    cpuHand.textContent = '🤖';
    resultEl.textContent = 'Choose your weapon';
    resultEl.className = '';
    toast('Score reset');
  });

  paint();
  return {
    enter() {
      playerHand.textContent = '❔';
      cpuHand.textContent = '🤖';
      resultEl.textContent = 'Choose your weapon';
      resultEl.className = '';
      busy = false;
      paint();
    },
    leave() { busy = false; }
  };
})();

/* ============================================================
   9. MEMORY MATCH
   ============================================================ */
const Memory = (function () {
  const SYMBOLS = ['🍕','🚀','🎧','🐱','⚽','🎮','🌈','🍩','🔥','💎','👾','🍀','🍉','🎸','🌟','🪐'];
  const LEVELS = {
    easy:   { cols: 4, total: 8 },
    medium: { cols: 4, total: 12 },
    hard:   { cols: 5, total: 20 }
  };

  const grid = $('#memoryGrid');
  const elMoves = $('#memMoves');
  const elPairs = $('#memPairs');
  const elTime = $('#memTime');
  const elBest = $('#memBest');

  let level = store.get('gz_mem_level', 'easy');
  let deck = [], firstCard = null, secondCard = null;
  let lock = false, moves = 0, matched = 0, pairsTotal = 0;
  let seconds = 0, timer = null, started = false, running = false;

  function fmtTime(s) {
    return Math.floor(s / 60) + ':' + String(s % 60).padStart(2, '0');
  }

  function bestKey() { return 'gz_memory_best_' + level; }

  function paintBest() {
    const b = store.get(bestKey(), null);
    elBest.textContent = b === null ? '—' : b + ' mv';
  }

  function paintLevels() {
    $$('.lvl').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.level === level));
  }

  function stopTimer() { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; running = false; }

  function startTimer() {
    if (running) return;
    running = true;
    timer = setInterval(() => {
      seconds++;
      elTime.textContent = fmtTime(seconds);
    }, 1000);
  }

  function build() {
    const cfg = LEVELS[level];
    pairsTotal = cfg.total / 2;
    matched = 0;
    moves = 0;
    seconds = 0;
    started = false;
    running = false;
    firstCard = secondCard = null;
    lock = false;
    stopTimer();

    elMoves.textContent = '0';
    elPairs.textContent = `0 / ${pairsTotal}`;
    elTime.textContent = '0:00';
    paintBest();

    const pool = SYMBOLS.slice(0, pairsTotal);
    deck = [...pool, ...pool]
      .map(sym => ({ sym, id: Math.random() }))
      .sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);

    const cols = (window.innerWidth < 420 && cfg.cols === 5) ? 4 : cfg.cols;
    grid.style.setProperty('--cols', cols);
    grid.innerHTML = '';

    deck.forEach((card, i) => {
      const el = document.createElement('button');
      el.className = 'mcard';
      el.dataset.idx = i;
      el.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Memory card ' + (i + 1));
      el.innerHTML = `
        <div class="mcard-inner">
          <div class="mface mfront"><span>?</span></div>
          <div class="mface mback"><span>${card.sym}</span></div>
        </div>`;
      el.addEventListener('click', () => flip(i, el));
      grid.appendChild(el);
    });
  }

  function flip(i, el) {
    if (lock || el.classList.contains('flipped') || el.classList.contains('matched')) return;

    if (!started) { started = true; startTimer(); }

    el.classList.add('flipped');
    Sound.play('flip');

    if (!firstCard) {
      firstCard = { i, el };
      return;
    }
    if (firstCard.i === i) return;

    secondCard = { i, el };
    moves++;
    elMoves.textContent = moves;
    lock = true;

    const a = deck[firstCard.i].sym;
    const b = deck[secondCard.i].sym;

    if (a === b) {
      setTimeout(() => {
        firstCard.el.classList.add('matched');
        secondCard.el.classList.add('matched');
        matched++;
        elPairs.textContent = `${matched} / ${pairsTotal}`;
        Sound.play('match');
        firstCard = secondCard = null;
        lock = false;
        if (matched === pairsTotal) win();
      }, 320);
    } else {
      setTimeout(() => {
        firstCard.el.classList.remove('flipped');
        secondCard.el.classList.remove('flipped');
        firstCard = secondCard = null;
        lock = false;
        Sound.play('miss');
      }, 760);
    }
  }

  function win() {
    stopTimer();
    Sound.play('win');
    const best = store.get(bestKey(), null);
    if (best === null || moves < best) {
      store.set(bestKey(), moves);
      paintBest();
      toast('New best: ' + moves + ' moves!');
    }
    elPairs.textContent = `${pairsTotal} / ${pairsTotal} ✔`;
    setTimeout(() => toast(`🎉 Solved in ${moves} moves · ${fmtTime(seconds)}`), 200);
  }

  $$('.lvl').forEach(b => {
    b.addEventListener('click', () => {
      level = b.dataset.level;
      store.set('gz_mem_level', level);
      paintLevels();
      build();
    });
  });

  $('#memRestart').addEventListener('click', () => { build(); Sound.play('click'); });

  return {
    enter() { paintLevels(); build(); },
    leave() { stopTimer(); }
  };
})();

/* ============================================================
   10. WHACK-A-MOLE
   ============================================================ */
const Whack = (function () {
  const HOLES = 9;
  const GAME_TIME = 30;

  const grid = $('#moleGrid');
  const elScore = $('#whackScore');
  const elTime = $('#whackTime');
  const elBest = $('#whackBest');
  const bar = $('#whackBar');
  const startBtn = $('#whackStart');

  let score = 0;
  let timeLeft = GAME_TIME;
  let playing = false;
  let spawnTimer = null;
  let tickTimer = null;
  let spawnMs = 820;
  let upMs = 900;
  let best = store.get('gz_whack_best', 0) || 0;

  elBest.textContent = best;

  grid.innerHTML = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < HOLES; i++) {
    const hole = document.createElement('div');
    hole.className = 'hole';
    hole.dataset.i = i;
    hole.innerHTML = '<div class="mole">🐹</div>';
    grid.appendChild(hole);
  }
  const holes = $$('.hole', grid);

  function resetBoard() {
    holes.forEach(h => { h.classList.remove('up', 'bonk'); });
    score = 0;
    timeLeft = GAME_TIME;
    elScore.textContent = '0';
    elTime.textContent = GAME_TIME;
    bar.style.width = '100%';
  }

  function spawn() {
    if (!playing) return;
    const free = holes.filter(h => !h.classList.contains('up'));
    if (free.length) {
      const hole = free[randInt(free.length)];
      hole.classList.add('up');
      setTimeout(() => {
        hole.classList.remove('up');
      }, upMs);
    }
    const progress = 1 - timeLeft / GAME_TIME;
    spawnMs = 820 - progress * 480;
    upMs = 900 - progress * 430;
    spawnTimer = setTimeout(spawn, spawnMs);
  }

  function tick() {
    if (!playing) return;
    timeLeft--;
    elTime.textContent = Math.max(0, timeLeft);
    bar.style.width = (Math.max(0, timeLeft) / GAME_TIME * 100) + '%';
    if (timeLeft <= 5 && timeLeft > 0) Sound.play('tick');
    if (timeLeft <= 0) endGame();
  }

  function startGame() {
    if (playing) return;
    resetBoard();
    playing = true;
    spawnMs = 820;
    upMs = 900;
    startBtn.textContent = 'RESTART';
    Sound.play('start');
    spawnTimer = setTimeout(spawn, 500);
    tickTimer = setInterval(tick, 1000);
  }

  function endGame() {
    playing = false;
    clearTimeout(spawnTimer);
    clearInterval(tickTimer);
    holes.forEach(h => h.classList.remove('up'));
    startBtn.textContent = 'PLAY AGAIN';

    if (score > best) {
      best = score;
      store.set('gz_whack_best', best);
      elBest.textContent = best;
      Sound.play('win');
      toast('🏆 New high score: ' + score + '!');
    } else {
      Sound.play('lose');
      toast('Time! You scored ' + score + ' point' + (score === 1 ? '' : 's'));
    }
  }

  grid.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => {
    const hole = e.target.closest('.hole');
    if (!hole || !playing) return;
    if (!hole.classList.contains('up')) return;

    hole.classList.remove('up');
    hole.classList.add('bonk');
    setTimeout(() => hole.classList.remove('bonk'), 220);

    score++;
    elScore.textContent = score;
    Sound.play('bonk');

    const pop = document.createElement('span');
    pop.className = 'pop-text';
    pop.textContent = '+1';
    hole.appendChild(pop);
    setTimeout(() => pop.remove(), 650);
  });

  startBtn.addEventListener('click', startGame);

  return {
    enter() {
      playing = false;
      clearTimeout(spawnTimer);
      clearInterval(tickTimer);
      startBtn.textContent = 'START GAME';
      resetBoard();
      elBest.textContent = best;
    },
    leave() {
      playing = false;
      clearTimeout(spawnTimer);
      clearInterval(tickTimer);
      holes.forEach(h => h.classList.remove('up', 'bonk'));
      startBtn.textContent = 'START GAME';
    }
  };
})();

/* ============================================================
   11. CARD BEST-SCORE REFRESH
   ============================================================ */
function refreshCardBests() {
  const boBest = store.get('gz_breakout_best', 0) || 0;
  $('#best-breakout').textContent = 'BEST ' + boBest;

  const ttt = store.get('gz_ttt', { x: 0, o: 0, d: 0 });
  $('#best-ttt').textContent = `X ${ttt.x} · O ${ttt.o}`;

  const rps = store.get('gz_rps', { w: 0, l: 0, d: 0 });
  $('#best-rps').textContent = 'WON ' + rps.w;

  const lvls = ['easy', 'medium', 'hard'];
  let bestMem = null;
  lvls.forEach(l => {
    const v = store.get('gz_memory_best_' + l, null);
    if (v !== null && (bestMem === null || v < bestMem)) bestMem = v;
  });
  $('#best-memory').textContent = bestMem === null ? 'BEST —' : 'BEST ' + bestMem + ' MOVES';

  const whackBest = store.get('gz_whack_best', 0) || 0;
  $('#best-whack').textContent = 'BEST ' + whackBest;
}
refreshCardBests();

/* ============================================================
   12. MISC UI
   ============================================================ */
$('#startPlaying').addEventListener('click', () => {
  Sound.play('start');
  document.getElementById('games').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
});

$('#year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();

$('#contactForm').addEventListener('submit', e => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const name = $('#cName').value.trim();
  const email = $('#cEmail').value.trim();
  const msg = $('#cMsg').value.trim();

  if (!name || !email || !msg) { toast('Please fill in every field'); Sound.play('miss'); return; }
  if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) { toast('Enter a valid email address'); Sound.play('miss'); return; }

  toast('✔ Message sent, ' + name + '!');
  Sound.play('win');
  e.target.reset();
});

$$('.card').forEach(card => {
  card.addEventListener('pointermove', e => {
    const r = card.getBoundingClientRect();
    card.style.setProperty('--mx', (e.clientX - r.left) + 'px');
    card.style.setProperty('--my', (e.clientY - r.top) + 'px');
  });
});

['pointerdown', 'keydown'].forEach(ev => {
  window.addEventListener(ev, function once() {
    window.removeEventListener(ev, once);
    try {
      const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
      if (AC) { const c = new AC(); if (c.state === 'suspended') c.resume(); c.close && c.close(); }
    } catch (err) {}
  }, { once: true });
});
</script>
</body>

Neon Breakout & Arcade Mechanics

Neon Breakout replaces Snake with a fast, responsive brick breaker that fits right into the existing arcade.

  • Control & movement – Move the paddle with your mouse, finger, or arrow keys (A/D also work). The game launches the ball automatically after a short countdown when a round starts or after losing a life.

  • Lives & scoring – You get 3 lives and start at level 1. Every brick destroyed gives 10 points; if all bricks are cleared, the level increases and the ball speeds up. Best score is saved in localStorage.

  • Pause & restart – Use the PAUSE/RESUME button, the RESTART button, or press Space/P to pause mid-game. Game over shows your score and allows a new run.

  • Responsive visual feedback – Glowing bricks, a gradient paddle, and a particle halo around the ball provide clear, immediate feedback. The canvas scales to fit its container and is playable on mobile.
